editorial:
Imagine the worst nightmare any parent could have: your child vanishes into thin air during a crowded Halloween party. That is exactly what happens to Mike Cole, and a year later, he is still a broken man. You get to follow him as he starts seeing weird images and getting creepy messages that seem to come from nowhere. He has to team up with his wife, even though they are barely speaking, to figure out if their son is still alive or if something much darker is trying to talk to them from the other side. The vibe is heavy and sad, but it keeps you guessing about what is actually real.

Nicholas Cage brings his usual wild energy to the role, which makes the emotional scenes feel very raw. The plot has some cool twists that will keep you awake, though some parts of the story move a bit slow in the middle. If you like mysteries that mix ghosts with family drama, you will enjoy this one. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that Mike's son didn't just vanish; he was kidnapped and killed by a man who wanted to use the boy for a dark ritual. The ghost of the son helps Mike find the killer's secret lair. In the end, Mike faces the villain and finds peace knowing where his son is. The movie wraps up with the family finally getting closure and the evil spirit being stopped for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves paranormal mysteries and emotional family stories.
